headline:
Hi, I'm Vairag.
I connect customer needs
to business decisions.
lead: I work on growth and operations at Jumbo Homes. I'm looking for founder's office, strategy, growth, and product roles where I can own a problem and see it through.
portraitCaption: An operator's experience. A learner's curiosity.

work.title: Owning a property sales pipeline
work.description: Supply onboarding, buyer qualification, visits, negotiation, and legal coordination. I keep the next action clear for customers and internal teams.

work.title: Seller outreach mail agent
work.description: Turned lead data into ready-to-review Gmail drafts so the supply team could spend more time on seller conversations and follow-ups.

work.title: A listing image workflow
work.description: Designed an AI-assisted process from raw property photos to listing-ready images, with three human approval gates. Prompts were validated; the full pipeline remains a design.

work.title: Bringing 5,000+ people together
work.description: Led sponsorship outreach, vendor negotiations, and event operations with 100+ core members and volunteers.
